coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore, hyphen or comb run: the characters' box (first to last character). Text tick box "/ /" or "[ ]": the three characters' box. Drawn rule: its x extent and the 10 pt above it. Drawn box: its rectangle.
how_measured: Vector geometry from pdfplumber (white filled rects and one white closed path on the grey ground; small white squares are tick boxes); underlines and the boxes in the agreement text measured on 300-400 dpi renders; captions read on 200 dpi renders; overlays looked at.

third_parties: financial advisor and office manager (item 13 and the advisor panel, pages 2 and 5)
custodian may sign the joint line for IRAs
signing.kind: Two versions of a commodity pool subscription agreement, each one form page plus its agreement text: Exhibit D(i) for the initial offering period (pages 1-3) and Exhibit D for the continuous offering (pages 4-6). The investor signs item 11 with a joint investor or custodian; the financial advisor and office manager sign item 13. No acceptance block for the general partner. Filed PDF with every word drawn as outlines (no text layer).

sure_per_page.2: sure of every white box (vector geometry); splits under captions in doubt; the advisor panel counted as one
sure_per_page.5: same as page 2 (the second version of the form)
